summary: Applied three fixes (narrator never shares a cast member's voice, the stack prop's figure no longer collides or leaves the frame, chapter timestamps pass the number check), added two maths kinds for long videos (step-up SIP, loan prepayment), and started one hook experiment for Shorts.
why: The quiet-bed experiment has 0 of 4 long videos per arm, so nothing to close. The highest-priority open items were an adopt/high voice fix from research, two template/high maths kinds and an adopt/high scene bug from Scout (long videos first at equal priority). The hook area had no running experiment.

findings.title: Evaluator
findings.detail: 5 videos with 48 h data. quiet-bed: WAIT, 0 of 4 long videos per arm. No recurring failures listed.

findings.title: Stack prop bug reproduced
findings.detail: Stills of L-20261019-01's 'total' beat showed the kicker over the figure; without a kicker the layout probe said '$11,638' ran outside the frame. After the fix both long and Short stills are clean.

findings.title: Maths kinds agree with the closed forms
findings.detail: 5,382 random input sets: renderer and number check agree except 8 half-unit rounding edges on prepayments in a loan's last months, which the number check rejects.

changes.title: Narrator never uses a speaking cast member's voice
New maths kinds sip_stepup and loan_prepay
changes.detail: renderer/models/maths.py, closed forms in generator/numbers.py, README table, examples/short_story_prepay.json, tests.

changes.title: Stack prop layout fix
changes.detail: remotion/src/props/money.tsx: lower stack, figure just above the top bill.

changes.title: Chapter timestamps are not number claims
changes.detail: generator/numbers.py strips a leading timestamp on long-video description lines; test added.

changes.title: Started hook-voice-matches-frame
changes.detail: Shorts, 50%, prompt-only: the first line voices the on-screen hook within 8 words, no warm-up opener. Judged on 48 h views, 8 per arm.
